subject.title: Feature: Slack workspace file injection + global systemPrompt (parity with Telegram)

question: Should OpenClaw expose a Slack account/global `systemPrompt` config field, and what precedence should it have relative to per-channel prompts, wildcard channel defaults, DMs, MPIMs, and native slash commands?
rationale: The remaining gap is a new public Slack config surface, not a broken existing contract, and a prior global/DM prompt PR was closed because the local prompt-stacking shape was not maintainer-approved.

options.title: Define Slack Account Prompt Inheritance
options.body: Add a documented account/global Slack prompt field with explicit precedence and tests across normal messages, DMs, MPIMs, wildcard channel defaults, and native slash commands.

options.title: Keep Per-Channel And Wildcard Prompts Only
options.body: Close or narrow the request if maintainers decide the existing per-channel `systemPrompt` plus `channels.slack.channels['*']` fallback is the intended API despite DM and MPIM limitations.

options.title: Defer Until Raw-Text Includes Land
options.body: Wait for the generic `$includeText` config API before revisiting prompt-file ergonomics, while tracking Slack global inheritance as a separate product decision.

recommendation.title: Define Slack Account Prompt Inheritance
recommendation.body: Add a documented account/global Slack prompt field with explicit precedence and tests across normal messages, DMs, MPIMs, wildcard channel defaults, and native slash commands.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner supplied the clearest maintainer-visible boundary in the merged Slack prompt work and the closure of the earlier global/DM prompt PR.
